events.title: Shadow Mate Free Demo Launches October 15!

events.title: Shadow Mate is Coming to Tokyo Game Show 2026！
events.summary: Shadow Mate will be exhibiting at Tokyo Game Show 2026, taking place from September 17–21!If you're attending TGS2026, we'd love for you to stop by and visit us!Shadow Mate has now reached approximately 16,000 Steam wishlists! events.title: New Trailer Released!
events.summary: The latest gameplay trailer for *Shadow Mate* has been released.Explore a ruined research facility, confront terrifying creatures, and uncover the chilling truth hidden in its depths.Add the game to your Steam wishlist now and look forward to the playable demo scheduled for release in September 2026.*Shadow Mate* is also set to be exhibited at Tokyo Game Show 2026!Official Website: https://www.shadow-mate.com/ Official X: https://x.com/shadowmate_dev
